name: Heritage Plaza
summary: Heritage Plaza is an HEB-anchored shopping center serving as Floresville's primary retail destination for groceries and essential services. Located on 10th Street, this community-focused plaza provides convenient shopping options for Wilson County residents with extended daily hours.
demographics: Heritage Plaza primarily serves the Floresville community and surrounding Wilson County area, attracting middle-income families and working professionals with household incomes ranging from $40,000 to $75,000. The trade area draws a mix of Hispanic and Anglo residents, with shoppers typically aged 25-65 who prioritize convenience and value in their daily shopping needs. As an HEB-anchored center in a small Texas town, it functions as a primary destination for grocery shopping and essential services, with visitors making frequent weekly trips for household necessities and routine errands.
description: Heritage Plaza serves as a vital commercial hub in Floresville, Texas, a historic town located approximately 30 miles southeast of San Antonio. Anchored by HEB, one of Texas's most beloved grocery chains, this shopping center provides essential retail and services to the residents of Wilson County and the surrounding rural communities. The plaza's strategic location on 10th Street makes it easily accessible to local families and commuters alike, offering convenient shopping options in a town-center setting. With operating hours from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, Heritage Plaza accommodates the schedules of working families and provides a reliable destination for daily necessities and community services. The center's strong rating of 4.4 stars from over 500 reviews reflects its importance to the Floresville community as a dependable and well-maintained shopping destination.
